components.name: Art Gallery Entry
components.description: Image-led warm exhibition entry with an outlined keyboard focus state.
components.html: 繪作走進展廳 ↗
components.css: .ds-art-entry { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: #eee5d6; color: #302820; text-decoration: none; font-family: "Outfit", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; } .ds-art-entry__frame { display: block; padding: 7px; background: #493a2e; box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(59,43,26,.21), 0 3px 7px rgba(59,43,26,.16); transition: transform 550ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-art-entry__mat { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 7rem; height: 9rem; padding: 1rem; background: #f5f0e5; font: 500 1.4rem "Zen Kaku Gothic New", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; } .ds-art-entry__label { border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; padding-bottom: .2rem; } .ds-art-entry:hover .ds-art-entry__frame, .ds-art-entry:focus-visible .ds-art-entry__frame { transform: translateY(-5px); } .ds-art-entry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9d592e; outline-offset: -5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-art-entry__frame { transition: none; } .ds-art-entry:hover .ds-art-entry__frame, .ds-art-entry:focus-visible .ds-art-entry__frame { transform: none; } }

components.name: Photography Gallery Entry
components.description: Cool photographic entry with staggered paper prints.
components.html: 影作開啟攝影地圖 ↗
components.css: .ds-photo-entry { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem; background: linear-gradient(155deg,#f1f4f6,#dce5eb); color: #283846; text-decoration: none; font-family: "Outfit", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; } .ds-photo-entry__stack { position: relative; display: block; width: 8rem; height: 10rem; } .ds-photo-entry__back, .ds-photo-entry__front { position: absolute; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 5.5rem; height: 7rem; padding: .5rem .5rem 1.5rem; background: #f8f8f5; box-shadow: 0 16px 31px rgba(55,74,89,.19), 0 3px 6px rgba(55,74,89,.12); transition: transform 550ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-photo-entry__back { right: 0; top: 2rem; transform: rotate(7deg); } .ds-photo-entry__front { left: 0; top: .5rem; z-index: 1; transform: rotate(-3deg); font: 500 1.4rem "Shippori Mincho", "Noto Serif JP", serif; } .ds-photo-entry__label { border-bottom: 1px solid currentColor; padding-bottom: .2rem; } .ds-photo-entry:hover .ds-photo-entry__front, .ds-photo-entry:focus-visible .ds-photo-entry__front { transform: translateY(-8px) rotate(-1deg); } .ds-photo-entry:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9d592e; outline-offset: -5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-photo-entry__back, .ds-photo-entry__front { transition: none; } .ds-photo-entry:hover .ds-photo-entry__front, .ds-photo-entry:focus-visible .ds-photo-entry__front { transform: none; } }

components.name: Framed Artwork
components.description: Square wood frame and mat; art image remains at its own aspect ratio.
components.css: .ds-art-button { padding: 0; border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-art-frame { display: block; padding: clamp(.28rem,.55vw,.5rem); background: #594435; box-shadow: 2px 3px 5px rgba(31,24,18,.18), 8px 18px 32px -10px rgba(31,24,18,.32); transition: transform 500ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-art-mat { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 11rem; height: 8rem; padding: clamp(.55rem,1.4vw,1.1rem); background: #f7f3e9; color: #403a32; font: 400 1rem "Zen Kaku Gothic New", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; } .ds-art-button:hover .ds-art-frame, .ds-art-button:focus-visible .ds-art-frame { transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-art-button:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-art-button:focus-visible .ds-art-frame { outline: 2px solid #403a32; outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-art-frame { transition: none; } .ds-art-button:hover .ds-art-frame, .ds-art-button:focus-visible .ds-art-frame { transform: none; } }

components.name: Selected Photo Print
components.description: Paper print with the selected shadow and open-image affordance.
components.css: .ds-print { display: block; width: 12rem; padding: clamp(.5rem,1.2vw,1rem); border: 0; background: #faf7ef; color: #39434a; text-align: left; box-shadow: 5px 25px 35px -13px rgb(36 42 43 / 35%); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 450ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow 450ms ease; } .ds-print__image { display: grid; place-items: center; height: 10rem; background: #dce5eb; font: 500 .75rem "Outfit", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .15em; } .ds-print__open { display: block; padding-top: .9rem; text-align: right; font: 400 .75rem "Outfit", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; } .ds-print:hover, .ds-print:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: 5px 30px 40px -13px rgb(36 42 43 / 40%); } .ds-print:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f4f63; outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-print { transition: none; } .ds-print:hover, .ds-print:focus-visible { transform: none; } }

components.name: Photo Selection Thumbnail
components.description: Numbered contact-strip frame with a clear selected underline.
components.css: .ds-thumb { position: relative; display: block; width: 5rem; padding: .25rem .35rem .6rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: transparent; color: #58656d; opacity: .65; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 180ms ease; } .ds-thumb__no { display: block; margin-bottom: .35rem; font: 400 .65rem "Outfit", sans-serif; text-align: left; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-thumb__image { display: block; width: 100%; height: 3.8rem; background: #dce5eb; } .ds-thumb:hover, .ds-thumb[aria-pressed="true"] { opacity: 1; } .ds-thumb[aria-pressed="true"] { border-bottom-color: #3f4f63; } .ds-thumb:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #3f4f63; outline-offset: 5px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-thumb { transition: none; } }

components.name: Metadata Chip
components.description: Stone metadata pill; the operable filter form gains a selected tint.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: .16rem .65rem; border: 1px solid rgb(217 123 46 / .7); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(217 123 46 / .12); color: #a3491f; font: 400 .72rem/1.5 "Outfit", "Noto Sans TC", sans-serif; letter-spacing: .05em; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 300ms ease, border-color 300ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: rgb(217 123 46 / .18); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a3491f; outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-chip { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio uses Japanese editorial spacing to make two bodies of work feel distinct. Digital artwork sits on a warm exhibition wall, held by a restrained wood-tone frame and mat. Photography rests on a cool silver work surface as loose paper prints; a selected print rises slightly above its neighbors. The original images carry the color and detail.

The shared language is quiet stone typography, precise hairlines, sparse terracotta or slate accents, and generous space around each work. Light and dark themes retain the same material relationships. Motion supports the act of looking and yields to reduced-motion preferences.
keyCharacteristics: Warm exhibition wall and cool photographic work surface.
Original-ratio artwork, small plaques, loose paper prints, and a visible selected state.
Asymmetric spacing and restrained material depth.
Distinct art and photography display type over a shared readable body stack.

rules.name: The Work Leads Rule
rules.body: Keep the original artwork and photography in color. Material colors create viewing conditions around each image.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Preserve the difference between the art world's geometric title and the photography world's Mincho title while keeping shared controls legible.

rules.name: The Viewing Distance Rule
rules.body: Give the selected work the most space, then let captions and neighboring works provide scale and context.

rules.name: The Material Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows describe wood on a wall and paper on a table. Use stronger depth only where selection or interaction raises the work.

dos: Do preserve original image identity, color, and aspect ratio in the work display.
Do use warm wall, wood, and mat for the exhibition, and cool surface plus paper for photography.
Do show light and dark material variants and a visible keyboard focus state.
Do make motion optional under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
donts: Don't let ornamental graphics or interface chrome compete with the actual work.
Don't make the museum frame or print stack a site-wide treatment for unrelated content.
Don't turn the photography selection strip into a second owner of the image URL or global scroll lock.
